summary.text: Brenda Miller is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 21, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Michelle Tweed (D).
A U.S. Army veteran and defense contractor, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she received the Bronze Star for service in the Iraq War.

paragraphs.text: Brenda Miller graduated from Pueblo South High School, served in the U.S. Army from 1981 to 2004, and earned a Ph.D. from Colorado Technical University in 2014; she lists her profession as defense contractor.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Miller said she entered the Army at 17, served during peacetime, provided humanitarian support during the Bosnia-Herzegovina conflict and served in the Iraq War, where she was awarded the Bronze Star.

She said she later worked at NORTHCOM, earned a doctoral degree with a homeland security emphasis, volunteered for seven years with the El Paso County Sheriff's emergency management and serves on a road impact board and the County Citizen Outreach Group.
